python3 - <<'PY' quarterly_report.docx
import zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'quarterly_report.docx'
RP = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
      'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

def esc(text):
    return text.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')

def para(text):
    return ('<w:p><w:pPr></w:pPr><w:r>' + RP +
            '<w:t xml:space="preserve">' + esc(text) + '</w:t></w:r></w:p>')

new_paras = [
    para('RECOMMENDATIONS'),
    para(''),
    para('Based on the strong fourth quarter performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, '
         'management recommends the following actions:'),
    para(''),
    para('\u2022 Prioritize continued investment in the Cloud Services segment, which delivered '
         'the strongest growth at 22.8% year-over-year, to sustain momentum and capture '
         'additional market share.'),
    para('\u2022 Accelerate international expansion to build on the 12.4% year-over-year revenue '
         'growth and diversify geographic revenue streams.'),
    para('\u2022 Maintain research and development investment at or above current levels to '
         'support the new product launches planned for 2025.'),
    para('\u2022 Scale marketing programs using the improved customer acquisition economics, '
         'leveraging the 8.3% decline in acquisition costs.'),
    para('\u2022 Preserve the existing hedging program and supplier diversification strategy to '
         'mitigate the currency and supply chain risks identified in this report.'),
]
insert = ''.join(new_paras)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    infos = zin.infolist()
    xml = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
    others = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in infos}

assert xml.count('<w:sectPr>') == 1, 'unexpected sectPr count: %d' % xml.count('<w:sectPr>')
xml_new = xml.replace('<w:sectPr>', insert + '<w:sectPr>', 1)

tmp = SRC + '.new'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for info in infos:
        data = xml_new.encode('utf-8') if info.filename == 'word/document.xml' else others[info.filename]
        zout.writestr(info, data)
shutil.move(tmp, SRC)
print('Recommendations section inserted successfully.')
PY
